subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should accepted non-transient gateway disconnects land as the narrow fresh-session fallback in this PR, or should this branch pause and implement reattach-first recovery instead?
rationale: Both paths are technically plausible, but the choice affects session state, duplicate model/tool execution, and possible duplicate delivery after the gateway has already accepted the run.

options.title: Land narrow fix, track reattach separately
options.body: Accept the timeout-style fresh-session fallback for this bug, update the docs for the new metadata value, and leave the broader reattach-first design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200.

options.title: Fold in reattach-first before merge
options.body: Require this PR to wait for the accepted gateway run first, reducing duplicate side effects but changing interactive disconnect behavior more broadly.

options.title: Pause for owner direction
options.body: Hold the PR until an owner decides whether recook-first fallback is acceptable for accepted disconnects at all.

recommendation.title: Land narrow fix, track reattach separately
recommendation.body: Accept the timeout-style fresh-session fallback for this bug, update the docs for the new metadata value, and leave the broader reattach-first design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200.
